contents.text: How do the service intervals change for a CP-200 pumping abrasive liquids?
The service intervals for a CP-200 pump are halved when it handles abrasive liquids. The CP-200 pump is not designed to handle abrasive liquids.

CP-200 Centrifugal Pump Operating and Maintenance Manual › 7 Maintenance › 7.2 Service intervals
## 7.2 Service intervals
| Task | Interval |
Halve the intervals for pumps that handle abrasive liquids or run above 60 °C.

CP-200 Centrifugal Pump Operating and Maintenance Manual › 2 Description
The CP-200 is a single-stage, end-suction centrifugal pump with a closed impeller, designed for clean or slightly contaminated water at up to 90 °C.
The pump and its motor sit on a common baseplate and are joined by a flexible spacer coupling, so the rotating assembly can be removed without disturbing the pipework.
A controller on the pump skid monitors the motor, the bearing temperatures and the seal-water pressure and trips the pump when a limit is exceeded.

Engineering change notice ECN-2291: CP-200 mechanical seal › Engineering change notice ECN-2291
| Title | CP-200 mechanical seal |
| Product | CP-200 centrifugal pump, all sizes |
Effective September 14, 2026, mechanical seal PN-4471-B is superseded by PN-4471-C on all CP-200 pumps.
Affected documents: CP-200 manual (2009) sections 7.2 and 8.1, and SOP-FS-014.
Affected parts

Engineering change notice ECN-2240: CP-200 casing wear ring material › Engineering change notice ECN-2240
| Change notice | ECN-2240 |
| Title | CP-200 casing wear ring material |
| Product | CP-200 centrifugal pump, all sizes |
Effective March 1, 2025, casing wear ring PN-2840-A (bronze) is superseded by PN-2840-B (carbon-filled PTFE composite) on all CP-200 pumps.
The bronze rings in stock may be used up on pumps that handle liquids above 80 °C, where the composite ring is not approved.
| PN-2840-A | PN-2840-B | Use up stock on pumps above 80 °C only |
Affected documents: CP-200 manual (2009) sections 6.2 and 8.1.
